TELI:T_AggregatorSample.TELI:description: Resource Monitoring ID (RMID) value for module 0 core 0. Assigned by OS/VMM by writing to IA32_PQR_ASSOC MSR.
Reserved for future use
Counts the total number of unhalted reference clock (TSC) cycles for module 0 core 0
Counts the total number of unhalted core clock cycles for module 0 core 0
Counts the total number of instructions retired for module 0 core 0. Counting continues during hardware interrupts, traps, and inside interrupt handlers.

Counts the total number of unhalted core clock cycles perceived by hardware as contributing to instruction execution (e.g., unstalled) for module 0 core 0. The ratio of PCNT/UNHALTED_CORE_CYCLES is an indicator of workload scalability (0% to 100%).
